name: buildflow
description: BuildFlow CRM — convenience scripts (server/ and web/ are independent packages)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
